summary: Add time-off approval flow for EOR employees
acceptance_criteria: Manager can see a list of pending time-off requests for their direct reports
Manager can approve or reject a request with a mandatory comment on rejection
Employee receives an in-app notification when their request is approved or rejected
Approved time-off is reflected in the employee's entitlement balance immediately
Request history is visible to both the employee and manager with status and timestamps

summary: Export time-off report as CSV for a given date range
acceptance_criteria: Admin can select a date range and download a CSV of all time-off requests in that period
CSV includes: employee name, employee ID, request type, start date, end date, status, approver name, approved/rejected date
Export respects the admin's legal entity scope — they only see employees in their entities
Export is available from the Time Off section in the admin panel

summary: Time-off request model and base API
acceptance_criteria: TimeOffRequest entity exists with fields: id, employeeId, managerId, type, startDate, endDate, status (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED), comment, createdAt, updatedAt
GET /api/v1/time-off/requests returns paginated list filterable by status, employeeId, dateRange
POST /api/v1/time-off/requests creates a new request with status PENDING
PATCH /api/v1/time-off/requests/{id}/status updates status (APPROVED or REJECTED) with comment
